brief:
Drop Site News is raising funds to support Huda Skaik, a Gaza-based journalist and contributor to the outlet, in pursuing studies at the University of London. The campaign aims to collect $50,000 by Wednesday to cover her educational costs.

Skaik has reported for Drop Site News from Gaza. Journalists in the territory face significant barriers in accessing higher education opportunities abroad.
dek: We have until Wednesday to help a Drop Site contributor raise $50,000…
title: Fundraiser seeks $50,000 to send Gaza journalist to University of London
